items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: And then these piano players in Isham Jones and Buffanos... So they hired me but they said they didn't want to do it, but afterwards they all liked me so much. (Lacks) and Captain John and all. Captain Vernon.

ctx.x: And he brought me, and they were not going to have me, these Streckfuss Brothers, because they were accustomed to that good piano that Fate Marable was playing. And then these piano players in Isham Jones and Buffanos, they were real piano players. And they wanted 'Kitten' on the keys, and I didn't play that too good. It was pretty difficult. But any way, they told Charlie they didn't want me, and so Charlie said if you don't want her you don't want my band. So if you hire me you have to have her, and I'll take…
Captain Vernon. They all liked me so much.
